arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 600 python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, time
cases = [
  '{"op":"compile","fib":' + '['*100000 + ']'*100000 + '}',
  '['*200000 + ']'*200000,
  '{"a":' + '['*50000 + ']'*50000 + '}',
  ' '.join(['1']*500000),
  '{"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[4096,4096,4096,4096],"max_stride":32}',
]
lines = cases + [json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[],'capacities':[4096]*4,'max_stride':32})]
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=300)
print('elapsed %.1f rc=%d' % (time.time()-t, p.returncode))
out=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print('responses', len(out), 'expected', len(lines))
for l in out: print(' ', l[:80])
print('stderr', p.stderr[:300])
EOF
